approaches.title: Binary search
approaches.summary: Uses binary search to locate the target or its insertion index in a sorted array. Revision 2 adopts a half-open interval to handle boundaries safely and return the insertion position directly.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements binary search over an inclusive index range and computes the insertion position after the loop.
Changes to a half-open search range, safely handles empty and boundary cases, and returns the final left index directly.
